There are two types — Number (integer) (a value that goes up and down, like affection or score: initial · min · max) and On/Off (a value switched on or off, like did · didn't: initial only). Where it is used: • Pin to base size — click the button at the right end of a card’s title row, left of the fit buttons (↔ · ↕), or double-click the empty part of the card’s header: the card returns to this size and fitting pauses (it keeps this size as you write). Click again to unpin: the card returns to its size before pinning and any fit that’s on fits again. With “Pin only the width to base size” below on, only the width goes to this width and only Fit width pauses — Fit height keeps fitting the writing box height. • New cards — new cards are this size. • Double-clicking a resize handle — the side that handle controls (width · height) returns to this size. • The lower limit of fitting — with the checkbox below on, Fit width · Fit height never shrink a card below this size, even for short text. Changing it leaves existing cards as they are (cards with fitting on refit right away). Already pinned cards keep the way they were pinned.

data.name: Settings_PinWidthOnlyTip
data.value: When on, pinning a card to base size sets only its width to the base width and pauses only Fit width — on a card with Fit height on, the writing box height keeps fitting the text. When off, both width and height go to the base size and all fitting pauses. Applies to cards you pin from now on — already pinned cards keep the way they were pinned.
